Decision: remove only full-context CLI scratch-alias blanket rejection. It was unnecessary and would change workspace geometry relative to L. The head-lease rejection remains, along with phase0/noMTP/exact262144/output0/int8/resident32768/explicit700MiB/noBorrow/noSplit/fresh/noRESTORE admission. No reserve shrink or physical lease is implemented.

Source proof and limits:
- Prefill init retains validate_gated_alias: gated1 requires scratch1, checked positive chunk and byte-product bounds. Both aliases independently require the Runtime compute queue in_order, as does layer-major. Count-only bytes_needed and init retain the same gate/region and emb/bo/ple/y omission rules.
- emb/bo/ple_emb alias: gr_broadcast's embedding reader precedes bo writes on cs; layer0's final gr_write precedes ple_land; layer1 PLE reads precede its first bo write. A layer-major per-layer run ending before layer1 still ple_land after the final bo read; later-layer runs do not read PLE embeddings. Each chunk/layer completes checked compute/copy drains before stores/owners are reused. These are the unchanged lifetime boundaries, not a new runtime proof.
- qkv/y alias: gdn_conv is the last qkv reader, followed by recurrence writing y on the same ordered queue; static_assert C>=ZV protects the view. HC gated/region alias: up projection produces the gate, gr_mix_r is its last reader before the first GDN/QSA/MoE region writer. PLE's local views occur before HC gate production.
- Target-only final callbacks consume only R (separate allocation), validate contiguous count/extent, and run only after run_impl checks stream_sync. They do not read scratch, launch drafts, invoke head, capture checkpoint or extend the KV span. Actual full-context setter requires a callback and n=capacity262144/pos0=0. Full span adds chunks; it does not enlarge chunk-sized alias views. Final partial chunk is bounded by allocated chunk capacity. All prior alias dependency/count/carve/queue/lifetime guards remain untouched.

Head/cache capacity evaluation: the target-only arm never invokes the head and does not mathematically need head logits or the ordinary decode expert-cache payload. However current startup loads native_head, allocates host/device logits, ordinary expert cache and other session/graph/verification owners before entering the standalone Prefill arm. Prefill init also takes the ordinary cache pointer before layer-major temporarily substitutes its private one-layer cache. They remain allocated; this source-only correction deliberately does not detach/free/rewrite those owners. Head-free or cache-free full physical lease would be a distinct ownership design, beyond this task. Fresh admission still charges all existing owners plus GPU/RAM residuals, private layer-cache, staging metadata and full700MiB reserve. R_GPU0 places full262144 FP32 residuals on RAM: 10737418240 bytes at width10240; positive prefix consumes additional VRAM by the existing planner. L free-memory arithmetic does not prove Q full-span or P post-lease fit; R407v2 explicitly distinguishes those phases. Zero output does not imply memory fit. No dtype/numeric/backend/pipeline change or unsupported capacity/speed/quality claim.

Main serial plan (all unexecuted here): retain intended L scratch1/gated1 flags for Q rather than switching to alias0; required free/contrib-llvm build/lint and helper/ASan fixtures when Main's current P slot is closed. Existing gated_region_layout_fixture covers alias/nonalias count/carve, bounded views, stock geometry and overflow/dependency source guards; v1 physical boundary fixture remains. Exercise malformed gated1/scratch0 and wrong queue guard where supported; CLI phase/head/MTP/reserve/context/count rejection. Full physical262144 target-only diagnostic requires matching pinned model/input/config and fresh admission or preserved refusal, zero output, final-layer full coverage/final page and checked close. Near-boundary GEN/final legal slot and numerical fixed-history comparisons remain separate. RESTORE is still rejected and needs its own all-state implementation and qualification. R405 physical-lease failure handling does not apply to this phase0 arm; its owner-release advice is not imported. R408 FP16/BF16 transport proposal is not implemented.

No builds, tests, lint, AST, GPU/model, profiling, cleanup, commit or push were executed. v1 source report wording scratchAlias0 is superseded only by this v2 decision. Latest registry named by Main as v195967 was not present in Q's accessible named capture directory (only v194 filename found); no qualification is inferred from that reference. Main's supplied L1024/32768 alias1 lifecycle evidence informs matching config, not full262144 validation.
